title: AIRO: A Streaming-Based Machine Learning Framework for Threat Detection and Security in Industrial Internet of Things
abstract: arXiv:2610.30713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) im- plementations now connect edge gateways, cloud dashboards and business applications. This improves visibility and remote monitoring. However it simultaneously exposes industrial traffic to various cyber threats including scanning, web attacks and Structured Query Language (SQL) injection (SQLi), phishing- driven credential theft, and command-and-control (C2) activity. Although rule-based tools remain useful for detecting known signatures, their efficacy decreases with minimally altered attacks or when alerts require manual investigation. This paper presents AIRO (Autonomous Intelligence-Driven Cybersecurity Risk Re- duction System), an efficient framework for IIoT monitoring and response. translated_title: AIRO：一种基于流处理的工业物联网威胁检测与安全机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 现代工业物联网（IIoT）部署现已连接边缘网关、云端监控仪表盘和业务应用，这提升了可见性和远程监控能力。然而，它同时也使工业流量暴露于多种网络威胁之下，包括扫描、Web攻击和结构化查询语言（SQL）注入（SQLi）、钓鱼驱动的凭证窃取，以及命令与控制（C2）活动。尽管基于规则的工具在检测已知特征签名方面仍然有效，但其在应对轻微变形的攻击或需要人工调查警报时效能会下降。本文提出了AIRO（自主智能驱动的网络安全风险降低系统），一个面向IIoT监控与响应的高效框架。AIRO结合了Apache Kafka流处理、针对特定攻击的特征提取、机器学习（ML）推理、基于置信度的决策逻辑，以及诸如互联网协议（IP）封禁等风险降低措施。
tldr: 该论文提出了AIRO框架，通过融合Kafka流处理、攻击特征提取、机器学习推理和基于置信度的决策逻辑，实现对工业物联网环境中多种网络威胁的实时检测与自动化风险降低。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AIRO, a streaming-based machine learning framework that combines Kafka streaming, attack-specific feature extraction, ML inference, and confidence-based decision logic to enable real-time threat detection and automated risk reduction in Industrial Internet of Things environments.
